criteria.priority_notes: Grants will be awarded to ensure at least one proposal focusing on each of the three Apply AI sectors: healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving. This is a procedural award priority applied post-ranking, overriding pure ranking order where needed to achieve sector balance, subject to all proposals passing evaluation thresholds.
